# Contributing

## 😄 Introduction / Welcome

Welcome! This Go module (library written in Go) is maintained by the [`@github/dev-frameworks`](https://github.com/github/dev-frameworks/) team. We welcome contributions from across GitHub: bug fixes, features, and more! Please note that this library is meant for general use across GitHub, so team-specific features may not make sense to add here.

To get started, open a new PR or submit an issue. We will be with you shortly!

## Workflow 🚀

1. For non-trivial changes, you may want to discuss them in the [#gophers](https://github-grid.enterprise.slack.com/archives/C0MQYTAG1) slack channel first.
2. Create a pull request
3. Address review comments and iterate until your PR is approved
4. Merge your commits into main
5. Ask for new release in the [#gophers](https://github-grid.enterprise.slack.com/archives/C0MQYTAG1) slack channel
